cells.scene: A person sees a coat hanging beside a closed door and imagines its owner inside in a thought bubble, no actual person visible behind the door.
A scheming person deliberately hides a friend's harmless party invitation behind their back, sly expression.
Two people secretly plan a harmless trick while whispering over a small sketch of their friend's chair, hidden behind a doorway.
A once-grand chess king lies toppled on its side beside upright pieces, a human organizer in background has lost their leadership badge.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — presume (v.假定): A person sees a coat hanging beside a closed door and imagines its owner inside in a thought bubble, no actual person visible behind the door.
TOP RIGHT — wickedly (ad.心眼坏地，居心叵测地): A scheming person deliberately hides a friend's harmless party invitation behind their back, sly expression.
BOTTOM LEFT — plot (v.密谋): Two people secretly plan a harmless trick while whispering over a small sketch of their friend's chair, hidden behind a doorway.
BOTTOM RIGHT — downfall (n.倒台，垮台): A once-grand chess king lies toppled on its side beside upright pieces, a human organizer in background has lost their leadership badge.
EXTRA CROP SAFETY: Draw noticeably SMALLER compact subjects. Every object, mast, roof, thought bubble and entire person must have an empty white border of at least 12% of its quadrant on ALL FOUR sides. Top row ends above 44% canvas height; bottom row starts below 58%. Never let a background tower extend upward into the midline. No part is clipped by a quadrant edge.
review_notes: All four scenes match their selected course meanings. Natural hands and faces; every drawing stays inside its quadrant with visible white crop margins.
